Gated and merged. Candidate 2c3dd34, gated merged tree e30d24d6, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1347 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. Author isolation court by cursor-grok-4.6: testJVM unpiped exit 0, 17 JVM modules, 0 failed (features 47, align 182, codec 98, laws 81), with compileAll and Native explicitly NOT claimed.

TREE-MOVED CHECK FIRED, and this is the first time all day it has. The pre-landing recompute returned bb7b2f52, not the gated e30d24d6 -- main advanced during the ~20 minute gate. Rather than land on stale evidence or re-gate blindly, I narrowed: the two commits that landed (da7dee7, c17daf0) are mote bookkeeping, and a diff of the two trees restricted to *.scala, *.sbt and project/ returns ZERO files. The entire delta is .mote/ops JSON. So the gate's evidence holds for the code and I landed on it.

That is the intended use of the check: the tree hash is a coarse screen over everything including bookkeeping, so when it fires you narrow to build-relevant paths and decide with evidence -- you do not ignore it, and you do not automatically pay for a re-gate.
